_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: writing the platform ad copy fields (headline, primary text, description, CTA, captions) for a paid ad, one channel or several. Should-not-trigger: the text drawn ON the image / the creative itself (generating-image-ads), a spoken voiceover or video script (writing-video-scripts), long-form copy (blog/email/landing page), and an off-topic control. Text-only deliverable — nothing generated.
trigger_keywords: write the copy for my ad
